const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Recorded low-level routine for the RoboLab snack disposal episode.
+
+Run one phase at a time so the camera and gripper opening can be checked:
+  python /app/output/gen.py observe
+  python /app/output/gen.py approach apple
+  python /app/output/gen.py grasp apple
+  python /app/output/gen.py lift apple
+  python /app/output/gen.py carry apple
+  python /app/output/gen.py release
+
+Repeat the object phases for yogurt after the apple is in the pail.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+CAMERAS = ["egocentric_mirrored_camera", "wrist_cam"]
+# Pixel-aligned depth from the initial static camera was back-projected using
+# obs.meta["cameras"][camera]["intrinsic_cv", "extrinsic_cv"].
+OBJECTS = {
+    "apple": {"xy": (0.571, -0.244), "grasp_z": 0.018},
+    "yogurt": {"xy": (0.436, -0.248), "grasp_z": 0.018},
+}
+# Mean of eight depth-back-projected points around the plastic pail's upper rim.
+BIN_XY = (0.335, 0.373)
+VERTICAL = np.array([0.0, -0.70710678, 0.70710678, 0.0], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def target(xyz, grip):
+    return np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=np.float32), VERTICAL, np.float32(grip)]
+
+
+def save_obs(robot, tag):
+    from PIL import Image
+
+    obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True)
+    stamp = f"{int(time.time())}_{tag}"
+    folder = OUT / "observations" / stamp
+    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{cam}.jpg", quality=92)
+    for cam, depth in obs.last_depth.items():
+        np.save(folder / f"{cam}_depth.npy", depth)
+    (folder / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+    print(json.dumps({"saved": str(folder), "done": obs.meta.get("done"),
+                      "reason": obs.meta.get("reason"),
+                      "time_left_s": obs.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+                      "tcp": obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][8:15],
+                      "gripper_opening_m": obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][24]}, indent=2))
+    return obs
+
+
+def move(robot, label, xyz, grip):
+    action = target(xyz, grip)[None, :]
+    res = robot.submit("ee_pose", action, cameras=CAMERAS, video_fps=5,
+                       video="both", note=label)
+    folder = OUT / "actions" / f"{int(time.time())}_{label.replace(' ', '_')}"
+    res.save(str(folder))
+    now = res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])
+    print(json.dumps({"label": label, "saved": str(folder),
+                      "done": res.meta.get("done"), "reason": res.meta.get("reason"),
+                      "plan": res.meta.get("plan"), "clipped": res.meta.get("clipped"),
+                      "tcp_now": now[8:15] if now else None,
+                      "gripper_opening_m": now[24] if len(now) > 24 else None,
+                      "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s")}, indent=2))
+    return res
+
+
+def main():
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        raise SystemExit(__doc__)
+    command = sys.argv[1]
+    object_name = sys.argv[2].lower() if len(sys.argv) > 2 else None
+    robot = Robot()
+    if command == "observe":
+        save_obs(robot, "manual")
+        return
+    if command in ("approach", "grasp", "lift"):
+        if object_name not in OBJECTS:
+            raise SystemExit("object must be apple or yogurt")
+        x, y = OBJECTS[object_name]["xy"]
+        z = OBJECTS[object_name]["grasp_z"]
+        if command == "approach":
+            move(robot, f"approach_{object_name}", (x, y, 0.22), 0)
+        elif command == "grasp":
+            move(robot, f"descend_{object_name}", (x, y, z), 0)
+            move(robot, f"close_{object_name}", (x, y, z), 1)
+        else:
+            move(robot, f"lift_{object_name}", (x, y, 0.34), 1)
+        return
+    if command == "carry":
+        move(robot, "carry_to_pail", (BIN_XY[0], BIN_XY[1], 0.36), 1)
+        return
+    if command == "release":
+        move(robot, "lower_over_pail", (BIN_XY[0], BIN_XY[1], 0.255), 1)
+        move(robot, "release_in_pail", (BIN_XY[0], BIN_XY[1], 0.255), 0)
+        move(robot, "retreat_from_pail", (BIN_XY[0], BIN_XY[1], 0.39), 0)
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"unknown command: {command}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
